title: Edmund and the Hollow Again
author: Beatrix Eastwick
blurb: Jonah Eastwick, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
